source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Steps in Hypothesis Testing' under topic 7.4 (PDF 98, printed 94).

blocks.text: Pehle null aur alternative hypotheses tay kiye jate hain. Phir significance level chuna jata hai. Samples se data jama hota hai. Test statistics nikale jate hain aur p-value maloom ki jati hai. Nataij ko significance level se milaya jata hai, aur accept ya reject ka faisla kiya jata hai.
